messages:
Sam K: Quick sync on the Acme POC — need to lock success criteria, timeline, and any security blockers. Customer is asking for a 3-week POC. Can we confirm latency/cost/quality targets + outstanding security asks? cc @Marta (SE)

Marta (SE): Available 2pm. Initial suggested acceptance targets: p95 latency < 350ms for main generation route, error rate <0.5%, quality pass_rate >= 90% on their human-eval rubric. Cost target: hosted equivalent < $0.30 / 1k tokens or a clear Dedicated comparison. Also need their prompt set + eval deck.

Sam K: They said they'll share 50 seed prompts + ~500 variations by EOD. They also want an A/B between quantized small model and full model to measure quality vs cost.

Asha Patel: For the POC config recommend: prefix KV caching enabled, batching target 32-64 (adjust per latency), and dynamic quantization profile for small-model runs. We'll surface quantization vs quality tradeoffs in the eval report.

Tony (AE): Pricing/Q: If they reserve 4 GPUs for Dedicated (monthly), what ballpark commit do we propose? Also customer requires EU-only data residency and SSO.

Marta (SE): 4xA10 equivalent reserved -> estimate $XXk/mo (I’ll pull exact pricing), but for POC we can offer a short-term discounted commit or Hosted with reserve bump for throughput. For SSO + EU region we can do VPC peering + regional hosting.

infra-bot: Note: provisioning Dedicated EU region can take ~5 business days after PO.

Marta (SE): POC plan draft: Week 1 = infra + SSO + data routing; Week 2 = run automated evals + human spot checks; Week 3 = tuning, canary A/B, and acceptance review. Acceptance criteria checklist: [1] pass_rate >= 90% on canonical eval set, [2] p95 < 350ms sustained, [3] error rate <0.5%, [4] throughput support for 800 rps sustained for 5m, [5] cost per 1k tokens < $0.30 (hosted-equivalent). If any single critical metric fails, we trigger remediation (model variant or config change) and re-run the acceptance tests.

Marta (SE): Eval command I'll run (example):
```
python run_eval.py --prompts acme_prompts.csv --model redwood-1.x --batch 32 --metric pass_rate
```
Acceptance: pass_rate >= 0.90

Tony (AE): Customer also sent a security questionnaire. Main asks: SOC2 report, ISO27001, KMS/BYOK, logging/audit retention, and optional HSM. Are we good to share SOC2 + KMS details?

Legal Bot: We can share SOC2 and standard security pack. For BYOK/HSM we need Solutions Eng + Security team alignment — potential timeline impact. Also confirm data deletion SLA and retention window (they asked 12 months).

Sam K: Customer confirmed 12-month retention acceptable. They asked if we can support BYOK for the POC; sounds like they want to test encryption flows.

Marta (SE): We can enable BYOK for Dedicated; Hosted BYOK is possible with extra setup. Expect additional 7-10 days for key exchange & validation. Recommend telling customer upfront.

Asha Patel: For the eval rubric please ask them to highlight 5 "must-pass" prompts and 20 secondary prompts so we can weight scores. Also ask whether tolerance for hallucination is zero for certain prompts.

Sam K: I'll request the prompt priority list and security questionnaire updates. Next steps: Marta to send POC runbook + acceptance checklist, Tony to update pricing estimate, Legal to send SOC2 + security pre-answers. Sync call tomorrow 2pm if that works. :thumbsup:
